item.description: Bola Tinubu says he was shaving last week when the water cut out - an experience familiar to many Nigerians.

item.title: Africanews: Cairo's honey festival showcases Egyptian honey bee industry
item.description: Egypt's capital welcomed the ninth edition of its annual honey festival between November 19 and 22.

item.title: BBC Africa: South Africa beaten by Ireland but still qualify for final
item.description: Ireland exact revenge on world champions South Africa with a thrilling win in Dublin after England's victory over New Zealand dashes Andy Farrell's side's hopes of reaching next weekend's Nations Championship final.

item.title: Africanews: Ukraine: Dramatic night rescue pulls woman from rubble after 22 hours
item.description: An elderly woman was rescued alive after spending 22 hours trapped beneath concrete slabs in Dymer, north of Kyiv. The death toll from Sunday's Russian strike on an apartment building has risen to 11.

item.title: Africanews: COP31 ends without agreement as divisions deepen over fossil fuels
item.description: UN climate chief Simon Stiell expressed disappointment over the outcome, warning that the failure to secure agreement on key presidency-led decisions must not be repeated.

item.title: Africanews: Tshisekedi and Ruto meet in Congo-Brazzaville to resolve DR Congo-Kenya rift
item.description: DRC President Félix Tshisekedi met his Kenyan counterpart William Ruto during a mini summit hosted in Congo-Brazzaville on Sunday. The two leaders pledged further relations after years of tensions over the DRC-Rwanda crisis.

item.title: Africanews: Indonesia: Rescuers recover 24 body bags from burnt-out factory
item.description: A devastating fire has gutted a confectionery factory near Jakarta, with authorities recovering 24 body bags from the wreckage. Rescue workers continue searching for missing employees as investigators examine the cause.

item.title: BBC Africa: Kenya and DR Congo agree to restore ties after tensions over conflict
item.description: The two leaders committed to upholding sovereignty and "non-interference in the internal affairs of states".

item.title: Africanews: UN calls for probe after drone attacks hit ships off Libya
item.description: There was no immediate claim of responsibility for either strike on Sunday off the port city of Benghazi, but they came as Ukrainian forces stepped up attacks against Russia far from the front lines.

item.title: Africanews: Brazil: Colourful costumes and dancing take over Copacabana Pride
item.description: Thousands of people filled Copacabana's beachfront in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, on Sunday 22 November 2026, for the city's 31st Pride Parade, celebrating LGBT+ diversity and calling for greater equality.

item.title: BBC Africa: More climate money for Africa? Europe says use what's already pledged
item.description: African countries at the UN climate summit in Turkey are demanding more funding from developed nations to help them cope with climate change.

item.title: Africanews: Drone strikes hit homes and UN premises in Sudan's capital
item.description: The United Nations confirmed that one of its premises, with UN personnel inside, was damaged in the attacks. It condemned the risks posed to humanitarian workers in civilian areas.

item.title: Africanews: Morocco: A surreal sculpture park turns the world upside down
item.description: An upside-down house, giant furniture and vegetable-headed figures await visitors at Ramakech, an 11-hectare sculpture park near Marrakech, where French artist Jean-François Fourtou brings childhood memories to life through extraordinary, larger-than-life installations.

item.title: Africanews: Egypt record first win, Mozambique fall in Under-17 World Cup
item.description: Egypt and Mozambique are both second in their groups, each with three points. They will need wins in their final group matches to strengthen their chances of reaching the next round.

item.title: BBC Africa: Explosion on Russian ship at Libya port caused by suspected drone attack, officials say
item.description: Libya's eastern government says the ship had stopped for fuel and supplies on its way back to Russia.

item.title: BBC Africa: Nigeria moves to end jail terms for attempted suicide
item.description: Nigeria's proposed reform follows years of calls from psychiatrists and a parallel Senate bill.

item.title: Africanews: Muhoozi named man of the match after Uganda’s goalless draw
item.description: MuhUganda were held to a goalless draw by Ecuador in their second Group B match at the FIFA U-17 World Cup on Sunday, leaving the Cranes needing a win in their final group game to reach the round of 32.oozi named man of the match after Uganda’s goalless draw.

item.title: Africanews: United Nations COP31 climate talks collapse in bitter row over fossil fuels
item.description: European nations, as well as many smaller climate-vulnerable countries rejected the draft deal which failed to mention fossil fuels.

item.title: Africanews: West Bank: Four Palestinian villages targeted in suspected settler attacks
item.description: Burnt-out cars, damaged trucks and anti-Arab graffiti were discovered in four Palestinian villages in the Israeli-occupied West Bank on Sunday 22 November 2026, following overnight attacks blamed by local activists on Israeli settlers.

item.title: Africanews: Drought strains Mauritius' agricultural sector pushing up food prices
item.description: El Nino-driven heat and the severe drought have slashed crop yields, raised irrigation costs, and sent food prices soaring.

item.title: Africanews: Ex-opposition leader to stand as independent in Burundi's presidential poll
item.description: Agathon Rwasa was ousted as leader of the National Congress for Freedom party in March 2024 by dissident MPs.

item.title: Africanews: Generations of Palestinians displaced by earlier conflicts live in limbo in Egypt
item.description: They face hurdles accessing education, healthcare, and other public services as they are considered foreigners.

item.title: Africanews: African football reaffirms support for re-election of FIFA's Gianni Infantino
item.description: CAF has been consistently behind Gianni Infantino who is seeking a controversial fourth term to 2031, despite criticism of his leadership.

item.title: Africanews: Ukraine: Up to seven feared trapped beneath rubble near Kyiv after Russian attack
item.description: A Russian strike partially destroyed an apartment building in Dymer, north of Kyiv, on Sunday. Nine people, including a child, were evacuated as rescuers searched the rubble for up to seven others feared trapped.
